category_edits.rationale: Apply fixed 0.5 residual damping to every NextItNet causal convolution block across all four datasets. The generated predictor imports this same model class, keeping training and inference consistent without changing checkpoint shapes, embeddings, readout, loss or optimizer.

response.change_summary: Halve each causal block’s residual update, preserving one independently trained NextItNet model per category and all existing training settings.
